The following events took place in approximately '''2000 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|BBY]]'''.

==Events==
*[[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Darth Ruin/Legends|Phanius]] fell to the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side]], became [[Darth/Legends|Darth]] Ruin,<ref name="END" /> and founded the [[New Sith]].<ref name="NEC" /> 
*[[Fourth Great Schism]]<ref name="The Jedi Path: A Manual for Students of the Force (real-life book)">[[The Jedi Path: A Manual for Students of the Force (real-life book)|''The Jedi Path: A Manual for Students of the Force'']]</ref> and the beginning of the [[New Sith Wars]].<ref name="END" />
*[[Human/Legends|Human]] colonists settled [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo's]] [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Rori/Legends|Rori]].<ref name="The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia">{{CSWECite|III|110|Rori}}</ref>
*[[Darth Phobos]]'s cult vanishes, and is presumably destroyed.
*A group of investors purchases the uninhabited [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Fresia/Legends|Fresia]].<ref name="CATCW95">''[[Coruscant and the Core Worlds]]''</ref>
*[[Bimmisaari/Legends|Bimmisaari]] and [[Hargeeva]] were colonized.
*The [[Shell Hutts]] colonized the planetoid [[Circumtore/Legends|Circumtore]].

==Battles==
Battles of the New Sith Wars ensued.
